The Nubisco icon family: one design language, one card per product. The living visual reference (rendered at 512, 48 and 28 px) is the [icon system artifact](https://claude.ai/artifact/D2T9CazKYEtsCgzDJ1jSof); this page is its permanent record in the manual. Master SVGs are attached to this document as they are finalized.

> [!NOTE]
> Acta documents cannot yet embed images inline in markdown, so the cards below are text-only for now. Once inline attachment rendering lands, each entry gets its icon displayed here.

## Design language

- **Ribbon letterforms**: the initial, sculpted as a tapering calligraphic band
- **Gradient along the stroke**: color travels the ribbon, as on the N itself
